clips.title: The story
paras: Master Vornal tests would-be pupils in Sen'jin Village as his eyesight fades. He asks them to gather makrura eyes and crawler mucus along Durotar's coast. Though he scoffs at taking an apprentice, the work tests patience and resolve.

Master Vornal lives in Sen'jin Village, where age has dimmed his sight. Primal magic once came readily to his fingertips, but now he relies on alchemy to sharpen his perceptions and weave his arts. Though his body weakens, the stubborn troll refuses an apprentice. He says neither the Darkspear nor Durotar's orcs have produced anyone worthy of his teaching.

Vornal asks for raw materials from the harsh coast: intact makrura eyes and vials of crawler mucus. Taking undamaged eyes from armored, snapping makrura calls for careful strikes. Gathering enough mucus tests whether a would-be pupil can endure tedious work. For Vornal, hunting these coastal beasts is less about the reagents than finding out who can keep their focus.

For Master Vornal, time and patience measure strength. He expects brash youths to grow frustrated or abandon the work. Bringing pristine ingredients back to Sen'jin Village shows survival skills along the dangerous reefs of the Echo Isles channel, and the discipline needed to master alchemy's subtle arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or traveler worthy enough has ever come forward.
Are you worthy? Yes, of course you are... Of course you think you are.
I need a few things. Will you get them for me?
I need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Time is the true test of your strength and will. Lose patience or give in to weakness, and your true self will be shown.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, young one... Well done indeed.
